decisions.reason: The superfood drink mix is only mentioned on the website and sits far from the firm's engineering core, so its weak visibility suggests results below aspiration, but the firm is hiring and reinvesting revenue, which gives it enough slack to carry the product another year.
The modular plant extensions build directly on the established waste-to-energy offer and need few extra resources, so there is little cause for problemistic search to remove them.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant has its own web page, which signals results that meet aspiration and a prominent place in the core portfolio.
The plastic-to-fuel plant fits the firm's strategic direction and is still in an uncertain early phase that the firm's slack can carry, although its limited visibility points to modest early results.
